tabList.name: Tab List
tabList.description: Shows a status dot next to player names in the tab list.

badgeWidth.name: Badge Width
badgeWidth.description: The space reserved for the dot in front of the player name.

dotOffset.name: Dot Position
dotOffset.description: Moves the dot to the left or right.

nameTag.name: Name Tags
nameTag.description: Shows a status dot next to the name above players' heads.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: Shows a status dot in front of chat messages.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: Get notified when a friend's status changes.

useLabyChat.name: LabyChat Friends
useLabyChat.description: Shows the live status of your LabyChat friends.

useLabyNetApi.name: laby.net
useLabyNetApi.description: Looks up player statuses on laby.net.

useMesh.name: StatusTag Sync
useMesh.description: Exchanges statuses with other players who use this addon.

statusColors.name: Status Colors
statusColors.description: Change the color of every status.

debugLogging.name: Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Writes a log file for troubleshooting. Keep this disabled unless you need it.

clearCache.name: Clear Cache
clearCache.description: Removes all saved statuses so they get looked up again.
